title: Move the persona-id operator tools (memory review, persona lab, feedback) from Agora to Management

runtime_budget.notes: Frontend page move and route redirects only. Same BFF reads/writes (agora learning client) and the same useLearningWriteAccess role/write gate; the only new read is the existing persona registry list for the picker.

acceptance_coverage.AC1: Memory review, Persona lab and per-persona Feedback are Management pages at /management/persona-tools/memory, /lab and /feedback (src/management/pages/persona-tools/, routed through src/routes/management/personaTools.tsx and App.tsx) and listed in the Research and Evolution sidebar group via managementRouteManifest.ts (nav.personaMemoryReview 人格記憶審核, nav.personaLab 人格實驗室, nav.personaFeedback 人格回饋). A PersonaPicker lists personas by name from bffV1.personas.list(); typing an id remains only under an advanced disclosure and a deep-linked id missing from the registry stays selectable. BFF calls (getMemoryReview, quarantineLessonCandidate, persona-lab reads/writes, submitHumanEvidence) and useLearningWriteAccess gating are unchanged.
acceptance_coverage.AC2: /agora/memory, /agora/persona-lab and /agora/feedback render AgoraPersonaToolRedirect (src/routes/agora.tsx): operator roles (admin, platform_admin, operator, ops, research_lead, reviewer, approver) go to the matching Management page keeping only ?personaId; every other session, including no roles, goes to /agora/trading-room; a loading session waits. Covered in src/routes/agora.test.tsx (operator and non-operator per path, loading/no-role, role set).
acceptance_coverage.AC3: Moved pages render enum values in words (scope, memory type, review/patch state, decision, evidence type via personaTools.enum.* with a humanized fallback) and show names/descriptions before ids; ids stay as a labelled secondary reference. The shared UnavailableNotice shows the owner reason humanized and folds the exact owner code into a closed details element. The sidebar entries feed the Management crawl by nav discovery; e2e/23-management-shell-fanout.spec.ts adds a readability assertion (enum_code, translation_key, internal_id findings must be empty) for the three pages. personaTools.pages.test.tsx asserts the three sidebar entries and that no sidebar target points into /agora.
acceptance_coverage.AC4: eslint . reports 0 errors (141 pre-existing warnings), tsc -p tsconfig.app.json, tsconfig.agora.json and tsconfig.node.json pass, full vitest run passes 293 files / 3642 tests including i18nParity and agora i18n guard. No test was deleted or weakened: the memory/lab/feedback describe blocks moved with their pages to personaTools.pages.test.tsx with all assertions kept; the two assertions that matched the raw owner status code 'rolled_back' now assert the word label on the element whose data-state is rolled_back.
acceptance_coverage.AC5: PENDING: hosted real-browser proof as admintest (three Management pages plus the three redirects, with screenshots) can only be captured after this PR merges and the dev FE deploy reports the merged commit in /deployment.json. Not claimed here.

changed_assertions.change: Moved from src/agora/pages/learning/learning.pages.test.tsx with the pages. Persona-lab undo test: toContain('rolled_back') on entry text became a data-state='rolled_back' element whose text matches /Rolled back|已復原/ (same check, before and after the refresh). All other assertions unchanged; the unavailable-reason assertions still pass on textContent because the raw owner code is kept inside the closed details element.
Only the memory, persona lab and feedback describe blocks and their three imports were removed (moved, not dropped); committee tests untouched and passing.

Treat the new e2e block as unverified until CI or hosted run.

residual_findings: Hosted proof (AC5) is outstanding until deploy.
e2e additions in e2e/23-management-shell-fanout.spec.ts are written but not executed locally (see verification.e2e).
scripts/lib/management-routes.mjs BASELINE_ROUTES (outside this task's declared artifacts) does not list the three new paths; the hosted crawl still discovers them from the rendered sidebar nav.

Trader feedback via the Agora drawer 'correction assistant' named in the task summary is not part of this change; Agora no longer offers a feedback page and non-operators are sent to the trading room.
Legacy keys agora.learning.tabs.* and agora.learning.persona.required are now unused by the moved pages and were left in place to avoid locale churn.
